meta.note: The app ships one light theme. There is no dark theme in the product, so none is defined here.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Primary buttons, active nav icon and label, links, the tick ring's progress arc, focus rings.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed primary; active sidebar label on primary-tint.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Active sidebar row, selected chip and segmented-control thumb background.

tokens.name: primary-tint-soft
tokens.usage: Hover row, quiet info panels.

tokens.name: logo-blue
tokens.usage: Logo: the clock ring and hands. The same blue as primary.

tokens.name: logo-blue-light
tokens.usage: Logo: the clock's centre dot. Mark only.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Logo: the bright face of the swoosh arrow. Mark only, never UI.

tokens.name: logo-green-dark
tokens.usage: Logo: the shaded face of the swoosh arrow. Mark only, never UI.

tokens.name: brand-50
tokens.usage: Marketing site: pill and soft panel ground.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Marketing site: pill border, light dividers on brand-50.

tokens.name: brand-300
tokens.usage: Marketing site: illustration mid-tone.

tokens.name: brand-400
tokens.usage: Marketing site: gradient mid-stop and the Discipline pillar accent.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Marketing site: text on brand-50, the Geniuses pillar accent.

tokens.name: brand-900
tokens.usage: Marketing site: deepest brand ink.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Marketing site: headings and body on white.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Marketing site: lead paragraphs.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Marketing site: captions and taglines.

tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: App page background behind every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, modals, the bottom bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a card: composer field, empty states.

tokens.name: surface-subtler
tokens.usage: Alternate rows, hover on white.

tokens.name: bubble-routine
tokens.usage: The routine's chat bubble (the user's own bubble is primary on white text).

tokens.name: drawer-header
tokens.usage: Avatar drawer header behind the name and D/K/G rings.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and bg-app.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Meta lines, inactive nav labels, routine times.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints and rule lines under a goal ('Needs 3 of 5 week milestones met'). Use at 13px+ only.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and struck-through done items. Never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Row separators inside a card.

tokens.name: divider-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules, card outlines where a shadow would clip.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and on toast-bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done: ticked checkbox fill, Done status pill, completed cascade cells, progress bars at 100%.

tokens.name: success-dark
tokens.usage: Success text on a success tint.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: The current routine and Active goals: 'now' badge, Active pill, open progress bar, today's cascade cell.

tokens.name: now-dark
tokens.usage: Text on now-tint; the Delegate quadrant.

tokens.name: now-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the Active pill and of today's cell.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and their confirm buttons.

tokens.name: danger-alt
tokens.usage: Missed state, failed agent, error icons.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational accents (Vuetify info).

tokens.name: stimulus-d
tokens.usage: D, Discipline (showing up on time). Its ring in the D/K/G trio.

tokens.name: stimulus-k
tokens.usage: K, Kinetics (movement and energy). Its ring in the D/K/G trio.

tokens.name: stimulus-g
tokens.usage: G, Geniuses (focused output). Its ring in the D/K/G trio.

tokens.name: priority-do
tokens.usage: Priority quadrant DO (urgent and important).

tokens.name: priority-plan
tokens.usage: Priority quadrant PLAN (important, not urgent).

tokens.name: priority-delegate
tokens.usage: Priority quadrant DELEGATE (urgent, not important): hand to an agent.

tokens.name: priority-automate
tokens.usage: Priority quadrant AUTOMATE: make it a routine.

tokens.name: agent-waiting
tokens.usage: Agent stage: waiting to start (breathing ring).

tokens.name: agent-running
tokens.usage: Agent stage: running (breathing ring).

tokens.name: agent-listening
tokens.usage: Agent stage: listening for its end event.

tokens.name: agent-firing
tokens.usage: Agent stage: end event firing (fast 1s rings). Same hue as now, told apart by the faster rings and the bolt glyph.

tokens.name: agent-finished
tokens.usage: Agent stage: finished.

tokens.name: agent-failed
tokens.usage: Agent stage: failed.

tokens.name: agent-stalled
tokens.usage: Agent stage: stalled, an end event that never came. Static, never breathing.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: The one toast (AppToast) everywhere: dark card, white text.

tokens.name: toast-success
tokens.usage: Toast icon: success (check_circle).

tokens.name: toast-error
tokens.usage: Toast icon: error (error_outline).

tokens.name: toast-warning
tokens.usage: Toast icon: warning (warning).

tokens.name: toast-info
tokens.usage: Toast icon: info (info).

tokens.name: bottom-bar
tokens.usage: Phone bottom navigation height.

tokens.name: rail

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: drawer
tokens.usage: Phone avatar drawer width (opens from the right).

tokens.name: content-max-home
tokens.usage: Desktop content cap on Home (checklist and chat split 60/40).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop content cap on every other page.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, the segmented control's thumb.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Text fields, composer, list tiles inside sheets.

tokens.name: radius-toast
tokens.usage: The toast card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs on phone; every labelled button.

tokens.name: radius-card-lg
tokens.usage: Cards on tablet and desktop; sheet top corners; modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, status chips, points chip, avatar, nav active pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Home cards and the chat composer. They sit level, so the card never floats above its own thread.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Default card elevation on the other pages (Vuetify v-card).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: The toast.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Centred modals and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: A selected card. Always inset, never outer: an outer ring is clipped inside scrolling columns.
